limitations: Mechanics/phase-controlled fixtures, not 18 candidate survival trials or a model-selected refuge.
30 final matrix cases; 2 targeted disconnect-alone rechecks remove the preceding operator stop. Earlier final disconnect cases exercised stop then disconnect.
42 development captures retained as provenance, not combined into the final matrix. v3 disconnect false negatives tested permanent HTTP closure instead of supervised restart.
Equip clock injected after first real inventory click; not a natural-latency estimate. Pathfinder equip delays are before original equip. Direct look delays hold completion after real look.
Collector drop freezes physicsTick delivery; pickup uses an item with PickupDelay 32767, removed by the server after replacement.
Replacement collector target is a sentinel for shared-state interference, not a second full collector job.
Danger control calls the real conditional stop for the fixture token; it does not measure session danger detection.
First observed movement is a bot physics sample at >0.2 blocks; RCON independently checks final arrival. No-threat handoff phases do not measure survival or knockback.
Terminal action timestamps establish actual revocation for external stops, not the earlier fixture marker used during orchestration.
Three final collector rechecks, after npm ci, assert the exact replacement target coordinates rather than only the remaining target count; all three still fail that assertion.
